serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Maybe you shouldn’t have called the Bible ‘mid’, huh? Maybe, just maybe, they wouldn’t have to exile us back here, because of it.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceAngry
Shanice: Oh yeah? Last time I checked there was a thing called ‘free speech’! Talk about fragile egos.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: We talked about it before and I’m not gonna explain it again. What happened, happened. {{wi}}And it was all your fault.
Shanice: Ugh!
These two didn’t change even a little…
Shanice: Whatever! I don’t need those jerks!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Language.
Shanice: Stop it! ‘Jerks’ isn’t even that bad!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s still a bad word, but I will let it slide. {{wi}}This time.
You: Wait a minute, they kicked you two out only because of this Bible stuff?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Oh, there was more. I can’t even repeat what she said because I would commit blasphemy, but what I can say is that she repeatedly called the Old Testament a ‘prequel’.
…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Yeah, yeah, I made a big blunder. Make fun of me.
Shanice: How was I supposed to know that they would get this mad over this? There was literally no way for me to know.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes, the education in this country was one of my concerns when I got here.
Shanice: I even resigned from my college for this job!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You are still getting the same amount of money!
Shanice: Well, yes, money is good, but that's besides the point!
Shanice: I can’t sunbath anymore and this city smells! 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: So those were your biggest concerns…
Shanice: Even you can’t be happy about returning here. It’s the worst!
Shanice: No offence, Anon.
You: None taken.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Let’s talk about something different. Anon, how were things going for you when we were gone?
You: The usual, I guess…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Haha! That answer is just like you!
Shanice: You need to be more open to people, you know? 
You: Thanks for the advice.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Anyway, how are things going between you and your lady? 
W-why is she mentioning her right now?! Priestbot is next to us?
You: I-I have no idea w-what you are talking about!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You are a horrible liar, you know that? Whatever, keep your secrets.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I will be going then. I reckon you two have something to talk about.
